text: Apex Logistics is wholly owned by Northwind Holdings, which is in turn controlled by Silverline Capital.
Viktor Petrov and Maria Lopez are directors of Silverline Capital.
Viktor Petrov also sits on the board of Kestrel Trading, which is on the OFAC sanctions list.
Internal investigation note: Cobalt IT Services shares its registered office at 14 Harbour Road with Kestrel Trading.
Evergreen Packaging is owned by Orion Ventures, a sustainability fund directed by Lena Novak.
Anita Desai approved BrightPath Supplies and Delta Facility Management, both low-risk office vendors.
Ravi Mehta approved Apex Logistics, Cobalt IT Services and Delta Facility Management.
Delta Facility Management subcontracts its night cleaning to Zenith Cleaning Co.
Bank alert: Zenith Cleaning Co. pays its workers through Harbor Pay Ltd, a payment agent under review.
Omar Haddad controls Harbor Pay Ltd and is also a shareholder of Kestrel Trading.
